game.wild_eyeballs_body: EyeBalls transform symbols into [[Wilds]], and bounces off Energy Fields!
game.mad_bonuses_body: 3 mad bonuses, with EyeBalls blasting across the grid in multiple directions!
game.eye_spy_body: A max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet, courtesy of the twisted genius!
game.eyeconic_desc: In this bonus, there is an increased chance of landing EyeBall symbols!
game.no_brainer_desc: In this bonus, each EyeBall symbol that activates will shoot in two different directions on one spin!
game.fs_retrigger_desc: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time during the bonus awards extra free spins.
game.its_electrifying_desc: In this bonus, at least 1 EyeBall symbol will land on every spin and EyeBall symbols that activate will shoot in two different directions!

external.bonushunt_featurespins_desc: Each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game!
external.zigzag_zappo_featurespins_desc: Each spin guarantees that at least 2 EyeBall symbol lands!
external.eyeconic_desc: 10 free spins with an increased chance of landing EyeBall symbols!
external.no_brainer_desc: 10 free spins with EyeBall symbols shooting in two different directions!
external.about_the_game_desc_2: The mad genius is at it again! Accompanied by Mr. Brain, they’ve successfully conducted a new experiment. A beast so ferocious it can trample an entire city in minutes! But don’t fear, the Doctor is here!
external.about_the_game_desc_3: Experiment with the mad duo in [[Dr Zappo]], a 5-reel, 4-row game with payline wins for an electric max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet, achievable in all game modes!
external.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_1: When an EyeBall symbol lands, it can only land on the 4th row of the grid. Once the grid has settled, all EyeBall symbols shoot in 1 of 3 directions: straight up, diagonally left, or diagonally right. EyeBall symbols activate in order from left to right.
external.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_2: When an EyeBall shoots, every paying symbol along its path transforms into a [[Wild]] symbol. These transformed symbols can remain [[Wild]] or reveal an Additive Multiplier value. [[Wild]] symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Multiplier values revealed on [[Wild]] symbols can be: [[2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x]].
external.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_3: If an EyeBall symbol hits an existing [[Wild]] symbol, that [[Wild]] symbol gains a Multiplier value. If an EyeBall symbol hits a [[Wild]] symbol with a Multiplier, the Multiplier value of that [[Wild]] will increase by adding a new Multiplier value to the existing [[Wild]] Multiplier. Multiplier values added to [[Wild]] symbols can be: [[1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x]].
external.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_4: Activated EyeBall symbols transform into [[Wild]] symbols. If more than 1 [[Wild]] Multiplier symbol is part of the same winning combination, the values are first added together before being applied to the win.
external.energy_fields_desc_1: There are 3 Energy Fields located on the left, top, and right edges of the grid. If an EyeBall symbol activates and hits an Energy Field, the EyeBall will bounce off the Energy Field and continue in another direction at the same angle. The EyeBall symbol will continue to transform paying symbols in its path into [[Wild]] symbols.
external.energy_fields_desc_2: When an EyeBall symbol hits a Energy Field straight on, the EyeBall will bounce back the same way it came from, adding Multiplier values to the transformed [[Wild]] symbols. If an EyeBall hits an EyeBall symbol, it adds a Multiplier value.
external.bonus_game_eyeconic_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.bonus_game_eyeconic_desc_2: This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics, with an increased chance of landing EyeBall symbols!
external.bonus_retrigger_desc_1: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:
external.bonus_game_no_brainer_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.bonus_game_no_brainer_desc_2: This bonus keeps the mechanics of the [[EYECONIC]] bonus. In addition each EyeBall symbol that activates will shoot in two different directions on one spin!
external.its_electrifying_bonus_info_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.its_electrifying_bonus_info_desc_2: This bonus keeps the mechanics of the [[NO-BRAINER]] bonus. In addition, at least one EyeBall symbol will land on every free spin! [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this bonus.
external.special_symbols_body: [[FS]] symbols cannot land at the same time as EyeBall symbols.
external.maxwingermany_body: Maximum win: [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times the total stake. Probability of getting the maximum win: 1:[[:oddsofmaxwin]]. The maximum win occurs when [[5]] EyeBall symbols land at the bottom of each reel, activating and transforming paying symbols into Wild symbols with random Multipliers being added to the transformed symbols, which will form winning combinations until the max win of [[10 000x]] is reached. The maximum win is the sum of all winning combinations when the reels are stationary, taking into account further winning opportunities such as bonus rounds and free spins. The maximum win can be achieved in the base game but is only possible with a lower probability if bonus rounds are excluded.
